request: Analyze GSE150620 for PMID 33123481 (Translating Preclinical Research for Exercise Oncology: Take It to the VO(2max).): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

other_accessions_not_analyzed.GSE129508: human window-of-opportunity RCT (Ligibel et al.), analyzed in S3.p5 / Fig 1A-B; not the requested series

final.assay: Lexogen QuantSeq 3' FWD RNA-seq of mouse left 4th mammary tissue with engrafted EO771 tumor cells; GEO deposits per-sample CPM
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 2 weeks of voluntary wheel running (before EO771 engraftment) vs sedentary housing on mammary-tissue gene expression, read out in the paper as a hypoxia signature score (lower in wheel runners)
final.sample_inclusion: Paper says 'mice randomized to exercise vs. control in GSE150620' (FIG1 C) and 'compared to sedentary control mice that also received mammary cancer' (S3.p6); it does not state n, nor whether the 10 clodronate-liposome (macrophage-depleted) mice were included
planned_contrasts: Wheel vs Control (sedentary) mammary tissue (S3.p6, FIG1 C; paper reports a hypoxia-signature TRA P = 0.003, no DEG count)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one mammary sample per mouse
final.paper_method: Transcriptome representation analysis (TRA) of a Buffa et al. hypoxia gene set (Supplementary Data File 1) on log2 expression; group difference in mean gene expression scores (FIG1 C). No gene-level DE model described.
final.normalization: GEO data_processing: STAR 2.5.3a normalized abundance, CPM per sample

paper_threshold.note: the paper reports no gene-level DE threshold; only gene-set TRA P values

paper_results.GSE150620: wheel-running mice had less hypoxia gene expression than sedentary controls (P = 0.003)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Perspective article; the only GSE150620 analysis is S3.p6 + FIG1 C: hypoxia-signature TRA, exercise vs control, P = 0.003, lower hypoxia with wheel running. No DEG list, no threshold, no sample counts. The GEO series is a 2x2 (activity x liposome) design from the same lab (contact D. Lamkin = first author); the paper does not mention the clodronate arm.

checks: S3.p6, FIG1 C and S5.p1 name GSE150620
GEO contact Donald M. Lamkin (UCLA) = author DL; ethics statement S6.p1 names UCLA IACUC
GEO tissue 'Mammary tissue with engrafted EO771 cells', wheel vs hub-shelter for two weeks before engraftment, matches S3.p6
22 per-sample CPM files in GSE150620_RAW.tar, one per GSM in the metadata

ownership.reasoning: Paper, accession, lab and protocol agree.

alignment.reasoning: Prep script renamed matrix columns to GSM accessions, so exact match on the metadata index (inspect: 22/22 on index and geo_accession). act = activity (Control->sed, Wheel->wheel); lip = liposome (PBS->pbs, Clodronate->clo); cell = act_lip for the cell-means model. Titles agree with the characteristics (Control_1-6 = sed/pbs, Wheel_7-12 = wheel/pbs, Clodronate_13-18 = sed/clo, WheelClodronate_19-24 = wheel/clo).

matrix.reasoning: GEO data_processing: 'Tab-delimited text files include CPM values for each Sample'. Column sums ~1.037e6 (1e6 plus the floor), minimum exactly 1.0 in ~74% of entries, non-integer otherwise: linear CPM with values below 1 set to 1. No raw counts deposited, so count models (DESeq2/edgeR/voom) are not available. Paper analyzed log2 expression (FIG1 C 'on log2 scale').

final.analysis_type: factorial (2x2 activity x liposome) cell-means model, limma

contrasts.name: wheel_vs_sed_pbs
contrasts.definition: wheel_pbs - sed_pbs (exercise effect with intact macrophages, 6 vs 6)

contrasts.name: wheel_vs_sed_avg
contrasts.definition: 0.5*(wheel_pbs + wheel_clo) - 0.5*(sed_pbs + sed_clo) (exercise main effect averaged over liposome, all 22 mice)

contrasts.name: wheel_vs_sed_clo
contrasts.definition: wheel_clo - sed_clo (exercise effect after macrophage depletion, 5 vs 5)

candidates.value: pool all 22 mice by activity, ignoring liposome (11 vs 11)
candidates.reason_rejected: clodronate is a randomized design factor with 10/22 mice; ignoring it would inflate residual variance and mix two conditions; the averaged-cell contrast keeps the all-mice estimand without that
same estimand as the primary cell-means contrast; fitting all 22 samples in one model gives a better variance estimate

design.reasoning: Paper (S3.p6) asks wheel vs sedentary control; it does not mention clodronate, so which mice entered FIG1 C is unknown. Primary = wheel vs sed within PBS liposomes (the untouched-physiology exercise effect, the paper's stated question); secondary = activity main effect averaged over liposome (uses all randomized mice, closest to a pooled reading of the paper); clodronate-arm and interaction contrasts exploratory. One cell-means model on all 22 samples.

covariates.name: lip_raw
covariates.disposition: design factor, modeled in the cell-means formula (not a nuisance covariate)

covariates.name: characteristics_ch1.4.replicate
covariates.disposition: excluded: within-group running index 1-6 (titles show distinct animals Control_1..WheelClodronate_24); not a pairing or batch key

covariance.reasoning: Independent mice, one sample each, one experiment; no subject or batch blocking.

final.method: limma (moderated t, empirical Bayes) on log2(CPM+1)

paper_route.method: TRA of the Buffa hypoxia gene set (Supplementary Data File 1)
paper_route.reason: gene set file (Table_1.XLS) not available locally and TRA is not an executor in this workflow; gene-level limma plus Hallmark-hypoxia GSEA used as the declared alternative

deviations: gene-level limma DE instead of the paper's gene-set TRA

duplicated gene symbols collapsed by highest mean CPM; 4 duplicated Excel-date IDs dropped (prep_merge_cpm.py)

method.reasoning: Linear CPM -> log2(x+1) -> limma (matrix policy). A cell-means design keeps both randomized factors and gives all four contrasts from one fit.

final.deviation_note: Paper reports no gene-level DE rule; workflow default BH padj < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff. Raw p < 0.05 shown only as a labelled audit count.

threshold.reasoning: S3.p6 / FIG1 C give only gene-set TRA P values.

caveats: Paper reports no DEG counts; comparison with the paper is the direction of hypoxia gene expression (expected lower in wheel runners), checked by Hallmark HYPOXIA GSEA
Paper does not say whether clodronate-liposome mice were in its exercise-vs-control comparison; both readings are run (PBS-only primary, liposome-averaged secondary)
Hypoxia signature differs from the paper's (Hallmark vs Buffa et al.)

study.reasoning: Paper genes listed are canonical hypoxia-signature genes (Buffa metagene members) used only to read direction; the paper itself names no genes for GSE150620.
